title: Calinium merchant interview session
description: Serializable, versioned merchant-intent session. A host application may persist this record; the interview engine itself does not select a storage provider or write Shopify data.

engine_version.description: Merchant Interview engine version. Older sessions migrate on resume.

catalog_version.description: Question catalog version used to collect answers. Older sessions migrate on resume.

created_at.description: Explicit creation timestamp supplied by the host.

updated_at.description: Explicit latest-update timestamp supplied by the host.

answers.description: Question ID to raw answer mapping. Question-specific validation is performed by the engine.

visible_question_ids.description: Deterministically resolved visible questions at the latest session state.

confirmed_summary.description: Merchant confirmation gate required before completion.

summary.description: Readable pre-strategy summary, populated only on successful completion.

merchant_profile.description: Canonical profile generated on completion; separately validated against calinium-merchant-profile.schema.json.

events.description: Ordered lifecycle events for host audit and resume behavior.
